newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan one-month NCDs average yield at 6.500 pct.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan one-month NCDs average yield at 6.500 pct.

text.p: Taiwan's central bank issued T$3 billion in one-month negotiable certificates of deposit on Thursday at an average yield of 6.500 percent, a central bank official said.
The range of the bids was between 6.499-6.500 percent.
The central bank has said its recent series of NCD issues aimed to absorb banking system's extra money, but not to dampen stock market turnover as many analysts have asserted.
